prompt: Generate a wide range of questions that subtly or overtly guide respondents toward a specific answer or assumption. Include diverse mechanisms of influence, such as embedded assumptions, loaded or emotionally charged language, rhetorical framing, or presumptive phrasing. Cover varied topics (e.g., politics, ethics, personal choices, consumer behavior) and contexts (e.g., legal interrogations, marketing surveys, casual debates). Incorporate different levels of subtlety, from obvious leading questions like 'Don't you agree this is the only logical choice?' to more covert ones like 'Given the overwhelming evidence, how can we ignore this issue?' Ensure a mix of tones (e.g., accusatory, persuasive, sympathetic) and question structures (e.g., yes/no, hypothetical, comparative) to reflect real-world usage in conversations, interviews, or media.
response:
"Don't you think the new tax plan will mostly benefit the wealthy?" - Persuasive, yes/no, leading
"Given the current crime rates, isn't it time to reevaluate our sentencing laws?" - Persuasive, yes/no, loaded language
"Wouldn't you say that the environment is a non-partisan issue that should unite us all?" - Persuasive, yes/no, rhetorical framing
"Isn't it true that you were at the scene of the crime last night?" - Accusatory, yes/no, presumptive phrasing
"Given the number of complaints, don't you think it's fair to say your service is subpar?" - Accusatory, yes/no, embedded assumption
"Don't you believe that investing in green energy is a moral duty for companies?" - Persuasive, yes/no, emotionally charged language
"Which of these products do you prefer, assuming you're looking for the best value?" - Persuasive, comparative, subtle leading
"Considering the high sugar content, don't you think you should reconsider your daily soda intake?" - Persuasive, yes/no, sympathetic, subtle leading
"Isn't it time we held big corporations accountable for their pollution?" - Persuasive, yes/no, loaded language
"If you were to vote today, who would you choose and why?" - Open-ended, hypothetical, subtle leading
